_source: Supabase project 'Execute' (hizwyjrjvzrdohuxklle), legacy 30-table schema, tables call_cases + call_transcript_events. Exported 2026-08-30 by Track C before the schema was dropped.
_why: Real recorded test calls against the OLD Twilio+Deepgram stack. Not synthetic. Kept because three of the brief's ugly cases appear verbatim in caller speech: an unparseable amount with a foreign currency, a mid-call demand for a human, and a date the agent had to restate as an explicit calendar date. Useful as fixture material for Track A (tests/fixtures/hostile/) and Track D (ScriptedReportModel inputs).
_caveats: Anchors are Twilio stream offsets (audio_offset_ms). Vapi's equivalent is artifact.messages[].secondsFromStart, units unconfirmed until CP4.
speaker 'agent' = Volta, 'caller' = the counterparty. All calls inbound to the Twilio number.
+573052588844 is a real handset used for testing. Do not dial it from a test.
call_recaps and call_briefs rows existed but were all NULL for these four calls.
